items.html: And from Tifferet and from Malchut, which are hidden, went out the sun and the moon; and this is from the side of the souls in it, for just as in Malchut, from the souls in her the Mayin Nukvin are made, as is known, so in the Yesod, the souls of the righteous in it, which are the stars, as I explained, they are the ones that raise the nine from above downward.
